info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Details API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Details API allows businesses to access specific information related to their corporate current accounts. By using this endpoint, users can retrieve key details about their account, enabling them to manage finances more effectively. Typically utilized by corporate finance teams and banking partners, this API streamlines operations by providing real-time data with ease. This functionality enhances decision-making and fosters better financial oversight for organizations.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a corporate current account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific corporate current account identified by its account number. It provides essential data that can help in managing and reviewing account activities efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body must be provided when retrieving the details for the corporate current account with the specified account number. Ensure the request format adheres to the defined schema for correct processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning account details.
